run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
run_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: run WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to copy wiki files with a version prefix using svn cp
run_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranchedFi: run WikiBrancher.UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to update internal wiki links in versioned branched files
review_WikiBrancher_GetFilesToBranch: review WikiBrancher.GetFilesToBranch to understand which wiki files are selected for branching
summarize_DropWikiSuffix: summarize the DropWikiSuffix function that removes the .wiki suffix from a filename
